title: 5 Euro Spring Surprises Copper Coin Set
descriptionPlain: If you are looking for a colourful, lasting Easter gift that is so much more original than giving banknotes, then this charming Easter set is just right for you. A cheerful potpourri of spring scenes is held in a green organza bag in the shape of seven 5 euro copper coins that all convey the same positive message – spring is here!Nature comes back to life with a hum, a flutter, a rustle and a crackle. A hare hops, a lamb grazes, a mare keeps a watchful eye on her frolicking foal, flowers shoot upwards and a meadow bursts into life.A gift card attached to the bag with a ribbon is decorated with the silhouette of an Easter bunny on the cover and space to write a personal message on the inside. But best of all, the set only costs the same as the face value of all seven coins, which are legal tender in Austria. The bag contains the following eight copper coins:Dürer`s Young HareFriends for LifeEaster ChickLittle I-Am-MeWaggle DanceGetting ThereNarcissusDürer’s Three Bunnies
